categories.main_business_segments: Antero Resources is primarily engaged in the exploration, development, production and acquisition of natural gas, NGLs (natural gas liquids) and oil properties located in the Appalachian Basin. The company operates through three reportable segments: (1) exploration, development and production of natural gas, NGLs and oil; (2) marketing of excess firm transportation capacity; and (3) midstream services through its equity method investment in Antero Midstream Corporation. The company targets large, repeatable resource plays using horizontal drilling and advanced fracture stimulation technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes horizontal drilling techniques and advanced hydraulic fracturing (hydraulic stimulation) technologies to economically develop and produce natural gas, NGLs and oil from unconventional formations in the Appalachian Basin. Key operational methods include cryogenic processing facilities for NGL extraction and separation, fractionation processes to break y-grade liquids into individual NGL products, and ethane rejection or recovery depending on market conditions. The company also employs leak detection and repair (LDAR) programs using optical gas imaging technology and balanced drill-out techniques to minimize emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company sells natural gas, NGLs and oil to energy companies, end users and refineries. Major customers include Six One Commodities LLC (12% of 2022 sales) and historically Sabine Pass Liquefaction LLC. The company serves Midwest-Chicago regional markets, Gulf Coast markets, Atlantic Seaboard and international markets through various pipeline connections. Production is marketed to local Appalachia markets and other preferred markets with favorable pricing through a diverse portfolio of firm transportation capacity.
categories.geographic_coverage: Antero Resources operates exclusively in the Appalachian Basin, with properties located primarily in West Virginia and Ohio, and some acreage in Pennsylvania. As of December 31, 2022, the company held approximately 504,000 net acres in this region. All of the company's total estimated proved reserves are attributable to properties located in the Appalachian Basin. The company's corporate headquarters is located in Denver, Colorado.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream and downstream segments of the oil and gas supply chain. Antero Resources is an upstream producer of natural gas, NGLs and oil, with significant involvement in midstream operations through its 29.1% equity interest in Antero Midstream Corporation. The company has dedicated gathering and compression services, water handling operations, and processing and fractionation services through Antero Midstream, and maintains firm transportation agreements with multiple pipelines to deliver products to end markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) maintaining a strong balance sheet with total debt reduction and sustainable leverage; (2) developing a focused, long-lived asset base with low geologic risk and repeatability in the Appalachian Basin; (3) securing sufficient long-term firm takeaway capacity on major pipelines; (4) fostering a culture of continuous improvement and responsible stewardship; and (5) achieving ESG goals including a net zero target by 2025 for Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions. The company is investing in methane emission reduction technologies, LDAR programs, pneumatic device replacement, and responsibly sourced gas certification.
categories.revenue_model: Antero Resources generates revenue primarily through the sale of natural gas, NGLs and oil production at market prices. In 2022, the company realized average prices of $6.92 per Mcf for natural gas, $20.41 per Bbl for ethane, $52.98 per Bbl for C3+ NGLs and $85.53 per Bbl for oil. The company also generates revenue from marketing excess firm transportation capacity on pipelines. Revenue is affected by commodity price volatility, production volumes and the company's hedging activities, which in 2022 covered approximately 49% of natural gas production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Antero Resources competes with other oil and natural gas companies, many of which possess greater financial, technical and personnel resources. The company faces intense competition for acquiring properties, marketing products and securing trained personnel. The company's competitive strengths include an experienced management team with a successful track record in unconventional resource plays, a strong balance sheet, a focused long-lived asset base in the Appalachian Basin with low geologic risk, and an integrated business platform with midstream capabilities through Antero Midstream.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, Antero Resources had total debt of $1.2 billion (reduced $942 million from prior year), total proved reserves of 17,759 Bcfe, and a PV-10 value of $29.5 billion. The company had 586 full-time employees and 295.2 million shares outstanding. In 2022, the company produced 1,170 Bcfe (3,204 MMcfe/d average daily production) and had capital expenditures of $986 million. The company's 2023 capital budget is $1.025-1.075 billion with plans to complete 60-65 net horizontal wells.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Antero Resources differentiates itself through: (1) a large, repeatable resource base of liquids-rich natural gas in the Appalachian Basin with low geologic risk; (2) an integrated midstream platform through Antero Midstream providing gathering, compression, water handling and processing services; (3) secured long-term firm transportation capacity to multiple markets reducing marketing risk; (4) a culture of continuous improvement and environmental stewardship with industry-leading methane emission reduction practices; (5) experienced management team with proven execution in unconventional plays; and (6) a strong balance sheet enabling sustainable development and return of capital to shareholders.
